propositions: Pass-1 context-limit escalation uses bare Anthropic model ids from MODEL_LADDER constant instead of respecting the run's provider qualification (Bedrock, etc.), causing provider mismatch when cfg.model carries a provider qualifier

The rung target decision in _rung_target compares only against the ladder constant without considering the actual run's primary model, so equality holds and escalation silently degrades to bare Anthropic family names
When a Bedrock-qualified primary escalates, cfg.model_provider is left untouched by replace(), composing invalid model ids like bedrock:claude-opus-4-8 that are not valid Bedrock names
The defect occurs on the common one-criterion retry (entry rung), not just rare deep-escalation cases, because models_at_or_above returns bare ids even for Anthropic primaries without a class table

Fix threads the run's primary model into _rung_target and returns None (drops) escalation targets whose inferred provider differs from the primary's provider, preserving byte-for-byte back-compat for same-provider cases
